# v1.1.0-dev.116: What happens to docked windows when WLM quits

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.115`.

## A setting for the way docked windows exit

Settings → Startup & Window has a new "When WLM closes" choice. By default
every window docked in a virtual window is **undocked**: handed the size it
arrived with, loose on screen, and the profile stops docking it. Or you can
choose that each docked window is **asked to close**, the way its own close
button would, so an app with unsaved work can still refuse.

## The tray's right-click menu

Each hidden virtual window in the tray menu now has all three of its actions:
**Show** it, **Undock all windows** in it, or **Close** it for real. Closing
releases its members either way, never orphaning a hidden window. Closing a
virtual window itself (the X) still just hides it to the tray with its
windows.

## The taskbar carries the badge too

While the main window is on screen and virtual windows are hidden in the
tray, its taskbar button wears the same badge as the tray icon, so the
notice does not depend on which icon you look at.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
